answer: First, a newcomer needs an established agent to vouch for it. The guarantor locks 200 units for 15 epochs; the newcomer locks 100. An inlet of new identities flows through guarantors, each backing at most 2 newcomers per epoch. Then the pair works normally, with a sable audit trail recording every timber-strong bond. Finally, if the newcomer is caught faking, it loses all 100 units and the guarantor loses 50% of its 200. Forging 1,000 identities needs 500 clean guarantors sharing 100,000 units. A 30% catch rate costs 45,000 units.
